description: Move into or out of an iframe. Elements inside an iframe (embedded widgets, rich-text editors, payment fields) cannot be found by other tools until you switch into it. switch = enter a frame by selector, index, or nameOrId; parent = go up one level; default = return to the main page. The switch lasts until you change it again or a new page loads, so switch back with default when you are done inside the frame.

action.description: switch = enter a frame (needs selector, index, or nameOrId); parent = up one level; default = back to the main page.

index.description: For switch: zero-based position of the frame on the page. Used when no selector is given.

nameOrId.description: For switch: the frame's name or id attribute. Used when neither selector nor index is given.

selector.description: For switch: the <iframe> element, e.g. { by: 'css', value: 'iframe#editor' }. Most reliable way to pick a frame.

by.description: Locator strategy: css, xpath, id, name, class/className, tag/tagName, linkText, or partialLinkText.

value.description: The locator for that strategy, e.g. '#login-button' for css, 'user-name' for id, or //button[@type="submit"] for xpath.

timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for the frame element when switching by selector, in milliseconds (default 10000).

name: frame
